description: Recorded evidence of the three-way build-tree hash reproducibility test performed during Stage 11C1: (A) initial build, (B) remove-and-rebuild, (C) clean npm ci + rebuild. All three produced the identical deterministic build-tree hash. During the Stage 11C1 audit corrective closure, an index.html change (adding Google Fonts <link> tags) was tried, verified to change the hash as expected, then DELIBERATELY REVERTED per audit instruction to leave the accepted bridge build infrastructure unchanged unless a correction genuinely requires it -- console-error classification (the actual correction required) does not require modifying index.html, only correctly explaining the existing asymmetry. The retained accepted hash below is confirmed unchanged after that revert.

method.reproduction_a: npm run build:bridge (fresh dist-vite-bridge, no prior removal needed on first run) then npm run hash:build
method.reproduction_b: rm -rf dist-vite-bridge dist-vite-bridge.tree-hash.json, then npm run build:bridge, then npm run hash:build
method.npm_ci_reproduction: rm -rf node_modules dist-vite-bridge dist-vite-bridge.tree-hash.json, then npm ci, then npm run build:bridge, then npm run hash:build

hash_algorithm_reference: v09/tools/hash-build-tree.cjs (documented canonical scheme: sorted relative paths, SHA-256 per file content, SHA-256 of the concatenated path+hash manifest)
